measurements.name: pearson_r_wavelength_sweep
measurements.method: Pearson r between fine-grid and coarse-grid fastest wavelengths across 12 diffusivity scales
measurements.reference_source: identity of σ(k) under grid refinement; 1 is the continuum limit, not the measured value
measurements.note: RMSE and residual CV are reported separately; value is not equal to the reference

measurements.name: rmse_wavelength_um
measurements.method: RMSE of coarse-grid λ against the fine-grid dispersion peak
measurements.reference_source: zero residual would be a perfect grid match

measurements.name: residual_cv_wavelength_sweep
measurements.method: CV of (λ_coarse − λ_fine) relative to mean |λ_fine|
measurements.reference_source: coefficient of variation of the sweep residual

measurements.name: linear_fastest_wavelength_um
measurements.method: argmax_k σ(k) at Dv/Du = 9 with Du fixed by the onset formula
measurements.reference_source: Delphi scale coordinate 0.0001843 m; not a scale-bar reading
measurements.note: near-threshold shift of the fastest mode away from the exact onset k_c

measurements.name: nonlinear_dominant_wavelength_um
measurements.method: Fourier shell of the saturated activator on the periodic patch
measurements.note: nonlinear shell need not sit on the linear onset mode

measurements.name: turing_max_growth_rate
measurements.method: max σ(k) in the Turing regime Dv/Du = 9
measurements.note: positive σ is the wavelength-selection instability

measurements.name: ablation_max_growth_rate
measurements.method: negative control: max σ(k) when Dv = Du (ratio 1, below r_c)
measurements.reference_source: Turing threshold; ablation must stay negative
measurements.note: null diffusion-ratio control versus the ratio-9 regime

measurements.name: specimen_chromatophore_dark_area_fraction
measurements.method: quantile segmentation of dark melanophore pixels inside the micrograph field stop
measurements.reference_source: model spot fraction on the rendered activator, a different image
measurements.note: specimen segmentation; value is not the model fraction

measurements.name: model_spot_area_fraction
measurements.method: same dark-phase quantile applied to the rendered simulation, not to the photograph
measurements.note: non-circular: simulation fraction versus specimen fraction

measurements.name: specimen_structure_tensor_coherency
measurements.method: mean structure-tensor coherency of the chromatophore micrograph

measurements.name: ks_statistic_luminance
measurements.method: two-sample KS statistic of field-stop luminance, specimen versus simulation; p-value stored in metrics
measurements.reference_source: KS = 0 would mean identical luminance distributions

measurements.name: radial_spectrum_pearson_r
measurements.method: Pearson r of 22-bin log radial FFT profiles, specimen micrograph versus rendered field
measurements.reference_source: r = 1 would be a copy of the specimen spectrum
